research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Intelline is focused on innovating in the field of power generation, as evidenced by their development of linear combustion engines with a valve in the piston. This technology integrates a combustion module with a linear motor, featuring a piston designed with an opening in the piston head. The approach aims to enhance the reliability and safety of power production, aligning with the company's commitment to revolutionizing traditional diesel engine packages. Intelline's R&D efforts concentrate on improving engine efficiency and performance.

product.name: CAVIE® Modular Linear Generator Systems
product.description: Modular, fuel-agnostic power-generation systems for industrial and commercial applications, scalable from 50 kW to 2 MW per genset and expandable through parallel operation.

product.name: CAVIE® Generator Modules
product.description: Adjustable generator modules that vary displacement, compression, valve operation, and fuel injection to maintain combustion efficiency across changing loads and fuel types.

product.name: Standalone Power Generation
product.description: Enclosed CAVIE® genset configurations that provide standalone electrical power from 50 kW to 2 MW, with additional capacity available through parallel systems.

product.name: Hybrid Vehicle Power Solutions
product.description: CAVIE®-based power-generation systems for hybrid vehicle drivetrains, providing fuel-flexible electrical power for heavy vehicle applications.
